## New
- **Profile:** tap your picture → "Edit profile". Upload a picture and set position and zoom, and change your name. The new name is also the one you sign in with
- **Reload the start page:** on the phone pull the start page down, on the desktop use the round arrow at the top right

## Fixed
- **Android updates:** every new version is now signed with the same key, so from this version on "Update now" installs over the app that is already there. To get there, uninstall Musik once and install this `Musik.apk`
- **Small player:** the progress line starts at the left edge of the player

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **Android:** uninstall Musik once, then install the new `Musik.apk`. After that updates work inside the app
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
